bead.title: Add maximum context length to eligibility and evidence
bead.description: Capture maximum configured context length for route candidates, record its source, and use EstimatedPromptTokens as an eligibility filter. Context headroom should also be available as a scoring component for otherwise eligible candidates.
bead.acceptance:
1. ModelInfo/Candidate/RouteDecision evidence includes context length and source: provider API, provider config, catalog, default, or unknown.
2. EstimatedPromptTokens rejects candidates whose max context cannot fit the request, with a typed FilterReason.
3. Context headroom appears as a score component for eligible candidates.
4. route-status --json exposes context length and source for candidates.
5. go test ./internal/routing ./cmd/fiz ./internal/serviceimpl -run "Context|EstimatedPromptTokens|RouteStatus" passes.
